resources.string: A series of fortifications made of stone, brick, tamped earth and wood.
Built over 2,000 years ago, the Great Wall is one of the most impressive architectural feats in human history, stretching over 13,000 miles across northern China.
A vast imperial palace complex in central Beijing, China.
The Forbidden City served as home to Chinese emperors for nearly 500 years and contains nearly 1,000 buildings with intricate traditional Chinese architecture.
A vast ensemble of lakes, gardens and palaces in Beijing.
Built in 1750, it is the largest and best-preserved imperial park in China, showcasing traditional Chinese garden design and landscaping.
A collection of terracotta sculptures depicting the armies of Qin Shi Huang.
Discovered in 1974, this ancient terracotta army was buried with the first Emperor of China to protect him in the afterlife, containing over 8,000 soldiers.
A freshwater lake in the historic city of Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province.
Known for its picturesque scenery and romantic landscape, West Lake has been featured in Chinese poetry and painting for over 1,000 years.
An imperial complex of religious buildings situated in southern Beijing.
Built during the Ming Dynasty, emperors performed sacred rituals here to seek blessings from heaven, representing the connection between heaven and earth in Chinese philosophy.
A waterfront area in the Huangpu District of Shanghai.
A historic riverfront promenade showcasing a unique blend of Chinese and Western architecture from the early 20th century colonial era.
A national forest park in Hunan Province featuring quartz sandstone pillars.
Famous for its towering quartzite sandstone pillars, this scenic area inspired the landscapes in the film Avatar and represents the natural beauty of Chinese mountains.
A fortress-palace situated on Red Mountain in Lhasa, Tibet.

Built in the 7th century, Potala Palace served as the winter residence of Tibetan Buddhist leaders and represents the pinnacle of Tibetan architectural achievement with 13 stories and over 1,000 rooms.
